name: KinFlo hosted activation owner approval packet
objective: Turn the hosted Convex activation human gates into one owner-facing approval packet with evidence targets, exact boundaries, and rollback posture before any hosted project, codegen, live smoke, provider write, or client launch is executed.

providerBoundary.notes: This packet records the approval structure only. It does not create/select a hosted Convex project, run codegen, import generated API, execute live functions, write providers, send invites, publish sites, import production data, or reveal secrets.

approvalMode.approvalStorage: No approval value is stored in committed source. Owner approvals must be captured in the live run notes or external review surface after Vambah explicitly grants them.
approvalMode.secretPolicy: Use 1Password, Convex dashboard, Vercel dashboard, or local environment files for secret values. Do not paste values into this packet, docs, commits, PR comments, or chat.
approvalMode.nextRepoSafeAction: Keep this packet current until the owner approves the first hosted activation gate.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Confirm whether any historical local secret exposure requires rotation before public or client sharing.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Secret-history audit result plus explicit rotation/no-rotation decision stored outside committed source.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Keep the repository private and pause all external/client sharing.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Choose a git history purge or an accepted private-repo residual-risk posture before external review.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Documented sharing posture and any purge command evidence stored outside committed source if executed.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Proceed to hosted Convex ownership and billing review.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Keep PR draft/private and do not invite clients or outside reviewers.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve hosted Convex project ownership, billing, backups, auth provider, environment policy, and operational owner.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Convex project URL, owner, billing, backup posture, auth policy, and env policy captured outside committed source.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Create or select the hosted Convex project and configure secrets outside git.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Keep all shell surfaces on fixtures and do not run hosted Convex commands.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve the env setup window and the exact moment to run npm run convex:codegen.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Codegen output reviewed against KINFLO_GENERATED_API_BINDINGS; generated files kept out of commit until reviewed.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Run npm run convex:codegen, review generated bindings, and decide whether to commit adapter changes in a scoped phase.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Remove generated files from the working tree and keep generatedApiAvailable false.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve a read-only hosted smoke window before mutation smokes.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: activation.readiness, viewer, role/access, tenant/site, public renderer, and launch readiness read outputs.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Run read-only smokes only, capture outputs, and stop before mutation writes.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Stop activation and keep fixtureKinfloShellAdapter selected if any read leaks scope or mismatches expected tenant/site boundaries.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve the mutation smoke order and rollback rules after read-only smokes pass.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Ordered mutation smoke records, audit events, cleanup notes, and rollback evidence for tenant, site, invite, publish, and lead flows.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Run mutation smokes in docs/convex-live-smoke-manifest.json order, one family at a time.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Archive smoke data, stop provider steps, and keep affected adapters fixture-backed on any permission, audit, or cleanup failure.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve replacing fixture reads with generated API bindings one surface at a time after smoke evidence passes.
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Surface-level adapter switch evidence, rollback confirmation, and no cross-tenant scope leak.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Switch one approved surface from fixtures to generated API bindings in a scoped PR phase.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Return the affected surface to fixture data and keep every other surface blocked until reviewed.

ownerApprovalChecklist.decisionNeeded: Approve non-Convex provider writes, client invite delivery, public publishing, and client sharing separately.
ownerApprovalChecklist.requiredBefore: DNS, billing, communications, storage, AI calls, public launch, or client handoff
ownerApprovalChecklist.evidenceTarget: Provider smoke packet with consent, unsubscribe, usage cap, source-safety, domain, billing, invite, and rollback proof.
ownerApprovalChecklist.allowedAfterApproval: Execute only the specifically approved provider/client action with its own rollback evidence.
ownerApprovalChecklist.rollback: Keep provider metadata local and leave sends/uploads/domain attachment/AI generation/client launch disabled.

blockedLiveActions: execute live Convex query, mutation, or action
switch the shell from fixtures to generated API bindings
send an invite, email, SMS, campaign, or provider request
attach or verify a live domain
share the repo publicly or with clients before secret-history decision
